LanguageData.LP_ForgeDeathknightPlate.label: forge death knight armor
LanguageData.LP_ForgeDeathknightPlate.description: A lich forges a suit of death knight armor from 150 steel and 200 sacrifice XP from the phylactery (can't start without enough XP).
LanguageData.LP_ForgeHelmRestlessDead.label: forge revenant great helm
LanguageData.LP_ForgeHelmRestlessDead.description: A lich forges a revenant great helm from 50 steel and 80 sacrifice XP from the phylactery (can't start without enough XP).
LanguageData.LP_ForgeCrownOfBone.label: make bone crown
LanguageData.LP_ForgeCrownOfBone.description: A lich makes a bone crown from 20 gold and 10 human leather.
